title: Central Excise Duty Rates Revised for Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Exports from October 16, 2026
content:
# Central Excise Duty Rates Revised for Petrol and High-Speed Diesel Exports from October 16, 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne Central Excise Duty Rates mein changes announce kiye hain, specifically for the export of certain petroleum products.

These revisions, effective from October 16, 2026, adjust the Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) rates.

*   **Revised Duty on Petrol Exports:** Rs 2.5 per litre (previously Rs 0.5 per litre).
*   **Revised Duty on High-Speed Diesel Exports:** Rs 8.5 per litre (previously Rs 16 per litre).
*   **Notification Details:** These changes are introduced via Notification No. 54/2026-Central Excise, issued on October 15, 2026.
*   **Amendment to:** This notification amends Notification No. 06/2026-Central Excise, dated March 26, 2026, by substituting entries against serial numbers 1 and 2 in its table.
